text:
anya: Quick follow-up on the precision budgeting RFC — want to lock down runtime API + ops playbook for mixed-precision lanes (fp8 / int8 / 4bit). Two main concerns: (1) per-route quality SLAs, (2) cost accounting and deterministic fallbacks. Thoughts?

devin: +1. can we get a minimal API proposal? I worry about coupling model names and lanes.

anya: sketch idea — request-level config that is model-agnostic and runtime-negotiated. example snippet:```json
{
  "precision_budget": {
    "lanes": [
      {"name": "fp8", "max_regress": 0.02, "cost_mult": 0.6},
      {"name": "int8", "max_regress": 0.01, "cost_mult": 0.8},
      {"name": "4bit", "max_regress": 0.05, "cost_mult": 0.45}
    ],
    "fallback_policy": "per_token"
  }
}```

priya: how do we measure "regress" here? per-eval-set delta or live metric? both? :thinking:

lee: prefer a two-tier check: offline eval-suite delta (gold prompts) + live detectors. live signals = top-k perplexity delta, QA F1 drop, and an embedding-similarity drift score. start canary at 3-5% traffic.

marco: ops POV: fallback needs to be deterministic and auditable. automatic fallback rules should include token-level fallback (downgrade lane mid-request) and request-level rollback (retry on safer lane). must emit event for each decision for billing & postmortem.

anya: runtime responsibilities: negotiate lane per-request, log decision metadata, and expose decision trace to tracing pipeline. example metadata payload:```json
{"lane":"int8", "reason":"canary-pass", "confidence":0.87, "fallback_count":0}```

devin: billing note: attribute realized token-cost = base_cost * lane.cost_mult. need to surface both nominal and effective token counts to customers and internal chargeback. also tie to reserved capacity buckets for dedicated customers.

priya: gating: require model-level calibration runs (calib-sweep) + bit-compat checks (no silent weight truncation). if calibration fails -> route to safer lane and mark profile as "untrusted". audit trail required.

lee: SLO wording suggestion: quality SLO = avg_eval_f1 >= baseline - delta within 99th pct request buckets over 24h. also monitor tail regressions per-customer.

anya: ops playbook (draft): canary -> monitor eval-suite + live drift -> if metric breach then auto rollback when breach > 3 sigma or >1% absolute failure for 30m. manual review required for exceptions. I'll draft this in the repo. :memo:

marco: safety nit: add a runtime lint that forbids 4bit on short answer classification tasks and on routes flagged "sensitive". flagging rules should be pluggable.

anya: good call. will add lint + CI check on quant profiles. I'll iterate and post a short RFC update this week. @sasha-bot can you schedule a 30m sync to finalize ops playbook? :calendar:

sasha-bot: meeting created: Precision Budgeting sync — Thu 11:00am, 30m. Invite: anya, devin, priya, lee, marco.

devin: thanks — one more ask: add a tiny backwards-compatible header so old clients can opt-out explicitly, e.g. `x-precision-opt-out: true`.

anya: yup will include that. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
